sample_unit: fictitious radiology reports (PARROT) plus 100 fictitious PET/CT reports

links.outcome: ICD-10 coding concordance and coding time for non-English versus English radiology reports
links.effect: Non-English reports had significantly lower concordance (first character p=0.002; second/third characters p<0.001; last characters p=0.012) and longer coding times (p=0.002) than English reports.
links.quote: Coding non-English reports resulted in significantly lower concordance (first character: p = 0.002; second/third characters: p < 0.001; last characters: p = 0.012) and longer coding times than English reports (p = 0.002).

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to assign ICD-10 codes to radiology reports to save coding time

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and time efficiency of an LLM (ChatGPT) for ICD-10 coding of fictitious radiology reports compared to manual coding, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
